name: POST /api/hdk-scanner/captures — hdk-scanner
description: Accepts a scanner capture from an offline-capable HDK client and queues it as hdk-scanner.code.captured.v1 for hdk-sync's conflict resolver (event-sourcing for image/video, lww for scanner). Answers 202 Accepted rather than 200/201: nothing is created synchronously — the route appends an audit entry and returns. The scanner records the capture only; it has no edit_history append. device_uuid is the sole required field — everything else is optional, so a payload that omits it is the only request shape this route rejects. Audit emission is best-effort and swallowed on failure, so a 202 does NOT prove the event was written; verify audit.entry rather than trusting the status.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in Bearer form - gateway default-deny authGate onRequest hook (AUTH_GATE_MODE=enforce)
Bearer token fails JWT verification in the gateway authGate
the request body has no device_uuid - the route's only validation

testCases.name: Queue a scanner capture for an attested device
